history_summary: Record two native species-reference correspondences for B8-1 and A1 in PAH Consortium 1.
history_details: The B8-1 and A1 species descriptors receive native Bacillus_A paramycoides and Bacillus_A paranthracis reference correspondences: respectively 9 genomes with fraction 1.0 and 210 genomes with fraction 0.99. These reference populations do not identify experimental stock assemblies; the rounded fraction does not imply an exact majority numerator. Preserve B8-1/A1 Consortium 1, its 16S marker uncertainty, planktonic versus static-biofilm assays, all measured substrate-removal endpoints and their limits. Bacillus_A is a lineage label difference, not formal stock renaming. Existing source/assay/optimization/marker findings 2317-2319 remain distinct. Only two selected GTDB blocks/statuses and two native inline events changed. The pinned table has no verified upstream release label. All prior history remains unchanged; this bounded technical correction does not complete scientific review or corpus QC.
